## Live replacement

**Live file swap: proven live.** switch_mods op=apply_live (and session_swap on an Eden session) writes the overlay edit, then SwitchLinuxAdapter.restart_title reboots the title in the SAME session/display/stream (PID changes); Eden has no save states, the round is lost, NAND saves kept. Checked live 2026-11-08.

**Pick whip: partial.** No screen-point pick (pick_tool has no Switch backend, no camera projection). The tactical map names each enemy by RAM class (enemy_identity) and a click sends the bot to it; model_swap redraws the player slot from the next fit-passing donor, an enemy class only reverts to native, at the next round.

**Live controls:** merc_live_controls re5: unlimited_health, infinite_ammo, infinite_spray, instant_qte, fire_rate 1-80, egg_rate, bow_rate, bullet_damage, turn_speed, kill_time; clicks flash_now, equip_primary, grenade_ring, model_swap. re5_mods tool routes Switch sessions to re5_switch_mods.

### RAM map `profiles/gamedata/010018100CD46000-ram.json` (010018100CD46000, little-endian)

The map holds no absolute fields (an ASLR title: the driver resolves module base + offset); its notes:

- MT Framework, 64-bit: every manager is a singleton whose instance pointer sits beside its class descriptor (MtDTI, 0x38 bytes: +8 name, +0x20 parent, +0x30 size>>2, +0x34 id); an object's class is the name its vtable's slot 5 (getDTI) returns.
- ASLR moves main every boot: every address is main's base (gbox.mercs.titles.re5_switch.module_base: 64 bytes of main's read-only data at +0x1191000) plus an offset, so this map holds no absolute fields; the driver reads them.
- Measured live 2026-10-26 on the Spark (Eden v0.2.1, single-core, NCE: a guest address is the host address) in The Mercenaries United, No Mercy, Public Assembly, Chris (BSAA): sMain base+0x26A1BA8 (sBioMain) +0x584E0 -> cGameSys (+0x944 phase 0/1/3, +0x948 f32 seconds left, +0x94C round time, +0x96C…
- The results screen agreed with cGameSys: Enemies Routed 9, Max combo 6x, Score 3,060 (docs/research/re5-switch-ram.md).
- Type D controls (the game's default): left stick moves, right stick turns (rleft = larger heading), ZL aims, ZL + ZR fires, L + ZR knife, ZL + B reload.
- Live mods (gbox.re5_switch_mods, the playing_ops): the weapon definition records at main+0x1D08680 (0x140 each, +0x1C the Gatling's 'needs no ammo' flag) and the player's time scale (+0x1A08) raised while his shot motion (+0x8F8 = 29) plays: held ZR 2.7 shots/s -> ~25 at x80 (live 2026-10-26).

## Gaps before a live swap / pick whip

- No zero-restart archive swap on Eden: switch_mods op=hotswap (same-length, in place) exists but recovery-hotswap-probe-20261109 has no recorded result; Eden packs the layered RomFS once per boot.
- No save states on Eden/Citron: every file swap reboots the title and loses the round (the incident report carries a 48 KiB RAM witness instead).
- No RAM path to the resource manager / loaded MOD pointers on Switch, so a mesh cannot change mid-round (RE6 X360 has sResource calls; Switch none).
- Screen pickwhip needs a view-projection (camera pos/target/FOV) and a pick_identify backend for Switch MT titles.
- donor_swap redraws only RE5 player slots; an enemy class can only go native, no per-carrier redraw.
- Sheva Clubbin/Tribal label mapping, which body a costume archive draws, s401-s407 names and the per-round FSM layouts are offline inferences.
- Eden boot stall (~2.65 s at the 2nd NVDRV channel; 2 of 9 boots on 11-06, 4 of 9 on 11-09) makes every restart-based swap a gamble without the boot watchdog retry.
